items.title: Aucanquilcha
items.description: Aucanquilcha is a large compound volcano in the Antofagasta Region of northern Chile, within the Central Volcanic Zone of the Andes. The volcano has the form of a ridge reaching an altitude of 6,176 metres (20,262 ft) above sea level, formed between 1.04 and 0.23 million years ago; there is ongoing fumarolic activity. items.title: Jensen Huang
items.description: Jen-Hsun "Jensen" Huang is a Taiwanese and American electrical engineer and businessman. He co-founded the technology company Nvidia, one of the world's most valuable corporations, and served as its president and CEO from its founding in 1993 until his resignation in November 2026. items.title: Ramayana: Part 1
items.description: Ramayana: Part 1 is a 2026 Indian Hindi-language epic mythological film directed by Nitesh Tiwari, who co-wrote the screenplay with Shridhar Raghavan. Produced by Namit Malhotra and Yash, the film is based on the Hindu epic Ramayana by Valmiki. items.title: Colette Kress
items.description: Colette Marie Kress is an American business executive. She has been the interim chief executive officer (CEO) of Nvidia since November 12, 2026, following the resignation of former Nvidia CEO and co-founder Jensen Huang amid a scandal.

items.title: Nvidia
items.description: Nvidia Corporation is an American multinational technology company headquartered in Santa Clara, California. items.title: Chris Van Hollen
items.description: Christopher Van Hollen Jr., also known as CVH, is an American attorney and politician serving as the senior United States senator from Maryland, a seat he has held since 2017. items.title: Piracy
items.description: Piracy is an act of robbery or criminal violence by ship or boat-borne attackers upon another ship or a coastal area, typically intending to steal cargo and valuable goods, or take hostages.
